content: A wife sought to enforce a separation agreement that gave her a 70% share of the house proceeds due to her parents' financial help,. The court analyzed the binding nature of pre-divorce agreements. The interpretive issue was whether these agreements held weight during the final judicial division. The judge confirmed that the specific percentages agreed upon during the separation were legally binding, and since the house was indivisible, it must be sold with the proceeds distributed according to the 70/30 split they had previously pacted.
